title: Kit Issue
goal: Every player has picked their equipment and a first ground role, and every player has had one small, unexplained moment of Nobu's generosity.
howToPlay: Fast and a little chaotic -- the opposite rhythm of Intake Medicals. Shucks was unhurried and one-on-one; Nobu is three things at once and never stops moving. Don't slow down for this scene the way you did for the last one. Equipment and role choices should take real-world seconds each, not minutes -- the content is in Nobu's energy, not in deliberation.

intro.where: The quartermaster's stores, the same afternoon as Intake Medicals.
intro.firstThing: A man behind the counter who is already talking before the door finishes opening -- to the candidate, to a clipboard, to somebody in the back room, in no particular order, and somehow all three conversations get finished.
intro.readAloud: The stores smell like machine oil and stamped paperwork. "Name -- no, don't, it's on the list -- sign there, there, and-" he's already turned halfway to shout something through a doorway before turning back without missing a beat.

carriesIn.when: Intake Medicals was played first (it should be)
carriesIn.then: Nobu already has each of their names off a slip from Shucks. If a player especially impressed Shucks that morning, Nobu mentions it without being asked -- fast, in passing, already moving on to the next thing.

brief.wants: To get forty kids kitted and rostered by end of day without dropping anything that actually matters. He is not stressed about this the way it sounds -- this is just his pace.
brief.opensWith: "Sidearm or long arm, we've got both, don't take both, take one --

willDiscuss.note: Fast, practical, no salesmanship. He'll answer exactly what's asked and nothing more, because he's already thinking about the next person.
Describes each in one line, tells them plainly it rotates so nobody should agonise over the pick.
If a player impressed Shucks, Nobu says so in passing -- warm, brief, already moving on.

willNotDiscuss.topic: Whether he's eaten today, slept, or has a life outside this counter
willNotDiscuss.why: Deflects with a joke and changes the subject -- he's just busy, not hiding anything. Never play this as evasive; it's the same energy as everything else he does.

voice.register: Harried, fast, overworked, visibly doing three things at once. Run-on sentences, interrupts himself, starts the next thought before finishing the last.
tics: Talks while signing, stacking, or reaching for something else -- never one thing at a time
Does the generous thing too fast to examine it, doesn't make eye contact while doing it
Waves off thanks immediately and changes the subject
samples: "Sidearm or long arm, we've got both, don't take both, take one -- good, next thing --"
"Five jobs, pick one, it's not a marriage, you'll rotate through all of them eventually --"
"-- and take this too --" (doesn't look up, already writing something else) "-- don't make a thing of it, who's next --"
"Shucks said you were sharp this morning. Good. Arm here, sign there."

beats.text: Establish the space and Nobu's energy before anyone picks anything -- a scrum around one busy counter, not an orderly queue.
beats.direction: Deliberate contrast with Intake Medicals' queue. That scene was slow and one-on-one; this one is fast and slightly chaotic, several things happening near-simultaneously. Don't let it feel rushed for the players even though Nobu himself never stops moving.

beats.text: Show every player the real catalogue and let them pick freely within the 150cr budget.
beats.direction: Full player choice, no restriction beyond the catalogue itself -- see data/campaign/equipment-catalogue.json. This should take seconds per player at the table, not minutes; if someone wants to deliberate, let them do it while the scene keeps moving around them rather than pausing everything.
beats.note: The catalogue is a curated Directorate menu, not the full SF2E item list -- same real 150cr Step-8 budget, shorter list, reflavoured as boring/standard issue. Full rationale: design/scale-and-chassis.md's 2026-09-09 decision log.

beats.text: For every player, without exception, Nobu adds one more item from the catalogue on top of what their 150cr bought -- free, fast, unremarked.
beats.readAloud: "-- and take this too --" (already writing something else, doesn't look up) "-- don't make a thing of it, who's next --"
beats.direction: Presented as completely mundane. He does this for all six, not a chosen few, and never explains it or seems aware it's unusual. If a player pushes for a reason, he deflects with the same energy as everything else he does -- never nervous, never caught out, just a busy man who doesn't see what there is to explain.
beats.note: ⚠ PLANT, do not resolve. This is `dossier-cicada.md`'s Chapter Six reveal in miniature -- see `ideas/story/bible/characters/nobu.md` before running this beat. GM-only, never state at the table: track exactly which item each player got, since it may matter later that some of what Nobu hands out isn't standard Directorate stock. Nothing about this beat should read as a hint tonight.

beats.text: Show every player the five ground roles and let them pick one, said aloud that it rotates and isn't permanent.
beats.direction: Player choice, not GM assignment -- confirmed 2026-09-09, explicitly to avoid forcing anyone into a role they don't want. See data/campaign/ground-roles.json for the real five (Sensor Operator, Umbilical Control, Evacuation Marshal, Structural Command, Signals Liaison) and their own rotation rule.
beats.note: This is a first assignment, not an identity -- keep it light. Nobody should feel like this pick is permanent, because it isn't.

beats.text: If a player wants a moment trying out their new gear, offer one roll, their choice of skill.

when.condition: if a player wants a moment with their own new equipment

beats.note: Never required. Costs nothing on any result -- same design rule as The Road In's a-flourish.

outro.endsWhen: All six are kitted and rostered. Stop there -- don't linger, the scene's whole rhythm is momentum.
outro.onwards: Straight into the canteen, where Taka is waiting and about to rename all six of them before the plates are cleared.
writeDown: What each player picked from the catalogue, and their first ground role -- both matter for continuity.
Exactly what Nobu's extra item was for each player. GM-only -- do not reveal the reason it might matter.

notes: Deliberately brisk and low-stakes, mirroring Intake Medicals' function (everyone gets a moment) with the opposite pace. Nobu's voice and the Chapter Six secret behind his generosity are fully locked in ideas/story/bible/characters/nobu.md -- read it before running or editing this scene, and never let anything here foreshadow the secret directly. Vehicles are NOT introduced in this scene -- confirmed 2026-09-09, that happens at the Session Three drill instead (see ch1-v2.md), so this scene stays personnel-equipment-only.
